target.statement: DnLUT attains 29.88 dB CPSNR on CBSD68 for Gaussian color image denoising at noise level σ=25, beating SPF-LUT (28.56 dB) by over 1 dB.

compute.basis: The DnNet is a tiny LUT-oriented CNN, but reproducing the table cell still requires training on DIV2K/Flickr2K/BSD400/WaterlooED for 2e5 iterations, converting to 3D/4D LUTs, and evaluating on the small public CBSD68 set; this is CPU-feasible but not instant.

blockers: If the GitHub repo lacks released pretrained LUTs/checkpoints, the 200k-iteration training run becomes the dominant CPU cost; the paper text does not specify patch size or full training configs.
title: DnLUT: Ultra-Efficient Color Image Denoising via Channel-Aware Lookup Tables
